integrity: All-dimensional implications are justified analytically; finite numerical tests are corroboration only. Equivalent less-indexed literature is possible.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the standard Euclidean uniform-matroid independence polytope at integer ranks (k-n/2)/sqrt(n) converging to a finite real c.
The Gaussian cube marginal is classical; the contribution is the two-scale joint width-loss limit, exact equality criterion, and its chi-square/zero-atom regimes.
No rate, general-matroid extension, non-Gaussian-direction universality, moment convergence, or independent validation is asserted.
title: A critical-rank Gaussian–chi-square width-defect law for uniform-matroid independence polytopes
